use_cases: Applying geometric clip-path masks to images for decorative layouts
Creating unique image shapes for profile cards and galleries
Masking images for creative hero section designs
Adding visual interest to image displays with non-rectangular shapes
Building masked image grids for portfolio or product showcases
ai_summary: An SVG-based image mask component that applies custom geometric clip paths to images, creating non-rectangular masked image effects. The component defines multiple clip path patterns using SVG clipPath elements with evenOdd fill rules. It renders as a container div and relies on external image content to apply the mask effect. Designed for creative image display scenarios in various web applications.
